CustomField.description: Provides a visual care-plan signal derived from the animal's current care status.
CustomField.formula: CASE( TEXT(Current_Care_Status__c), "Open", "Blue - Active care", "Planned", "Purple - Planned care", "On Hold", "Amber - On hold", "Closed", "Green - Care closed", "Cancelled", "Grey - Cancelled", "Grey - Not set" )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Derived automatically from Current Care Status for care coordination.
CustomField.label: Care Signal
